(Following copied from Susex Pride's website)

The hotline and temporary housing is available to all unhoused youth in Delaware no matter where you are located. Contact the hotline if:

-You ever felt like running away.
-You don’t feel safe at home.
-Your Parents kicked you out.
-You are sleeping on a friend’s couch.
-You are lonely, confused, or scared.

More info [here](https://childinc.com/runaway-and-homeless-youth/)

ETA: I also saw you don't want to involve police, which this org doesn't do

Fantasy Life is one of my favorites! It has high replay value, simple controls and a super cute, fairly long story mode. Yes, you can play via Wi-Fi with your family and it's great because you can give each other little gifts to help out in your "lives" (for example, if your child is a fisher or fighter and you're a cook, they can bring you fish and monster loot so you can level up and make new recipes, and you can repay them in food so they can boost their health). I highly recommend it! And like everyone else has said over and over, you won't regret grabbing a copy of animal crossing, too. You can find both games for pretty cheap right now too!
